# Overview
An online store checkout for shoppers buying physical goods.

# Personas
- Shopper — browses products, builds a cart, and pays.
- Store admin — manages the product catalog and views orders.

# Features
- A shopper browses the product catalog.
- A shopper adds and removes items in a cart.
- A shopper enters a shipping address and pays for an order.
- A shopper sees an order confirmation and their order history.
- An admin adds, edits, and removes products.
- An admin views placed orders and updates their status.
